user.title: Pair with Quartierfuchs
user.description: Create a pairing code in the Quartierfuchs portal under "Connect Home Assistant" and enter it here. The code is valid for 15 minutes.

data_description.code: The code shown in the portal, e.g. QF-7K2M-9XPA.
data_description.portal_url: Only change this if your Quartierfuchs portal uses a different address.

entitaeten.title: Share devices
entitaeten.description: Choose the devices Quartierfuchs may see and control. All other devices stay invisible to Quartierfuchs. You can change the selection at any time under "Configure".

reauth_confirm.title: Renew pairing
reauth_confirm.description: Quartierfuchs rejected the login, for example because the pairing was removed in the portal. Create a new pairing code in the portal and enter it here.

error.code_ungueltig: The pairing code is unknown, expired or has already been used.
error.portal_nicht_erreichbar: The Quartierfuchs portal cannot be reached. Please check the portal address and your internet connection.
error.ungueltige_antwort: The Quartierfuchs portal sent an invalid response.
error.url_ungueltig: The portal address must start with https:// (http:// only for testing on your own network).
error.unbekannt: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This pairing is already set up.
abort.falsches_konto: The code belongs to a different Quartierfuchs account than this pairing.

init.title: Share devices
init.description: Choose the devices Quartierfuchs may see and control.
